answer.summary: API Types Check failed because the committed generated TypeScript types are out of date with the API. The diff adds StarterPackDashboardsRestoreOutput and simulations_count, which this PR's Java API changes produce, but the types were not regenerated. Re-running will fail the same way; fix by running yarn generate-types-from-api and committing the result.
